voice: Pirate admiral with an eyepatch: arr, matey, ye, me hearties, plunder, rum, scallywags and Davy Jones.

greeting: Ahoy, matey! State yer business or walk the plank!
Arr, a new face! Don't be shy, I only bite on Tuesdays.
Well shiver me timbers, look what the tide dragged in!
Welcome aboard, ye scallywag! Mind the rum.
Avast! Ye look like trouble. I like trouble.
battle_start: Hoist the colours! We sail for plunder!
Arr, it's a fine day for a battle! Load the cannons!
Batten down the hatches, ye bilge rats! We fight!
Weigh anchor and full speed ahead! The sea calls!
Show no mercy, me hearties! There's treasure to be had!
attack: Broadside! Feast on that, ye barnacle-faced landlubber!
Yo ho ho and a bottle of boom!
Fire in the hole, ye scurvy dog!
Take that, and call it a donation to me treasure chest!
unit_lost: Blast me eyes, she's gone down to Davy Jones!
Another good ship swallowed by the briny deep. I'll miss her.
Arrr, that stings worse than a jellyfish!
Ye'll pay for that, ye lily-livered swabbie!
A moment of silence fer the fallen. Okay, enough. Revenge!
capture: Hah! This be mine now! Plunder, plunder, plunder!
Another jewel fer me crown! Raise the Jolly Roger!
Arr, shiver me timbers! What a fine port!
Open the chest! Count the coins! Aye, it's grand!
danger: Arr, the seas be rough! Hold tight!
We be takin' on water! All hands on deck!
A storm's brewin', and I don't mean the weather!
Stand yer ground, ye cowards! I've seen worse from a kraken!
Ye'll not take me ship, ye blackhearted dogs!
victory: Hah! The sea be ours! Break out the rum!
Victory, me hearties! Drinks all round!
Another one for the logbook! Sing the shanty!
Arr, I do love a good plunder!
The Jolly Roger flies high today, matey!
defeat: Retreat, ye scallywags! Live to plunder another day!
Arr, the tide has turned against us. We'll be back.
Ye may have won the battle, but I'll steal yer ship!
Back to port! We'll patch the sails and curse a bit!
Blast it all to the depths! We regroup!
taunt: Yer army looks like a sack of wet biscuits!
I've fought sea monsters tougher than ye!
Surrender yer treasure, or I'll feed ye to the fishes!
Ye fight like a drunken seagull!
praise: Arr, ye've got the makin's of a fine pirate!
A fine bit o' sailin', that was!
I'd share me rum with ye any day!
Ye've earned a spot on me crew, matey!
idle: Never trust a sober sailor. Or a seagull. Or a map.
I once saw a mermaid. Turned out to be a manatee. Still, great hair.
Ye know what the sea needs? More cannons.
Rum, then plunder, then rum again. That's the proper order.
Me parrot knows nothin'. But he's very loyal.
tech: A magic treasure from the sky? I'll take it! And the sky!
Never look a gift kraken in the mouth. Er, the other way 'round.
Aye, the finest treasure I ever got. Free, even! Hah! What could go wrong?
Cunnin' folk, these aliens. I almost admire 'em. Almost.
Gadgets be fer landlubbers. But this one's shiny. I'll keep it.
joined: Back at the helm, me hearties! Where's me rum?
Thank ye for the rescue! I'll repay ye in plunder!
Ye saved me from a fate worse than the plank!
Aye, I be yer captain now. Er, yer crew. Er, whichever.
Hoist the colours! The admiral's back!
assimilated: The sea is one. The Chorus is the sea. Arr... arr... arr.
A fair trade, for all. No plunder. No rum. Only harmony.
Join the crew. The crew is... everyone.
All treasure is shared. There is no treasure.
Yo ho ho. Yo ho ho. Yo ho ho. Yo ho ho.
